input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale:
The only indemnity in the Agreement (Article XII, p0128-p0129) runs one way: Licensee indemnifies Licensor for the exercise of the licence, the conduct of Licensee's business and any breach. There is no Licensor indemnity anywhere, and Article XIII (p0130) goes further by expressly excluding any Licensor liability for claims that use of the Licensed Technology infringes third-party intellectual property. That is walk-away territory under the rule (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity) and fails even the fallback, which requires at minimum a Licensor IP indemnity with standard exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies. Redline adds a Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with standard procedure and remedies, overrides the Article XIII carve-out for that indemnity, and narrows our indemnity to Licensee-provided content and Licensee's breach of law/material breach. We flagged in the comment that we can fall back to usual exclusions and a 3x annual fees super-cap.</rationale>

proposal.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity and narrow the one-way Licensee indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs one way only, and Article XIII disclaims any Licensor liability for infringement, so we carry all IP risk in technology we do not control. We have added a standard Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents and wilful misconduct (with notice/control/cooperation and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies), and narrowed our own indemnity to our content and our breach of law. If preferred, we can accept the usual exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and a super-cap of 3x annual fees on the Licensor indemnity.

ops.text: INDEMNITY BY LICENSOR. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement (including the preceding paragraphs of this Article XII and Article XIII), Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, API's, Documentation or any other materials or services supplied by Licensor infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data or Confidential Information caused by Licensor; or (iv) Licensor's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, tender control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the indemnified party may be made without its prior written consent) and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. If the Licensed Technology becomes, or in Licensor's opinion is likely to become, the subject of an infringement claim, Licensor shall at its expense procure for Licensee the right to continue using the Licensed Technology, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, or, if neither is commercially reasonable, refund the fees paid by Licensee. Licensor's obligations under this paragraph are not subject to the exclusions or limitations of liability in Article XIII.
